about: The data every published Robo-Kit number was computed from (snapshot 00a560f4a6d3, prices through 2026-08-31). Unpack with: python scripts/replicate.py data

v2/close_monthly.pkl.what: month-end total-return prices (dividends reinvested) of every candidate ETF, Yahoo Finance

v2/volume_monthly.pkl.what: monthly traded volume of every candidate ETF, Yahoo Finance

v2/usdcad_monthly.pkl.what: USD/CAD month-end exchange rate (CAD=X), Yahoo Finance

v2/context_monthly.pkl.what: market-context series (rates, VIX, credit spread, GPR, EPU), monthly

v2/context_meta.json.what: sources and as-of dates of the context series

v2/universe.pkl.what: the classified ETF universe the current engine ships with (3.0.3 labels)

v2/universe_v3_evaluated.pkl.what: the universe the registered v3 evaluation used (before the 3.0.2/3.0.3 relabelling)

v1/prices_daily_adjclose.csv.what: daily adjusted closes of the 20 ETFs of the v1 prototype

terms: Fetched from public sources (Yahoo Finance, TMX, Nasdaq Trader, Bank of Canada, FRED, GPR, EPU, GDELT) whose terms cover personal, non-commercial use; included so that a course reader can reproduce our results. See data/README.md.
